__broaden__.αὐτήν: αὐτός — self; fem. acc. sg., as a plain pronoun: ’her’ (καὶ αὐτήν ’and her too’) · also intensive, fem. acc. sg.: ’itself’ (κανόνας τε καὶ αὐτήν ’the rods and the shield itself’)
__broaden__.αὐτοὺς: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. pl.: ’them’ (grave, mid-clause form) · also intensive, masc. acc. pl., in apposition: ’themselves’ (καὶ αὐτοὺς Ἀργείους ’the Argives themselves’)
__broaden__.γένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, come to pass; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐγένοντο) · also with ἐν + dat.: ’reached, got to’ (κλισίῃσιν ἐν γένοντο ’reached the huts’) · also with ἄγχι + gen.: ’came near to’ (Ἕκτορος ἄγχι γένοντο ’came close to Hector’)
__broaden__.γυναικὸς: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. gen. sg., with ἐϋζώνοιο: ’of the well-girdled woman’, after χωόμενον · also fem. gen. sg., governed by ἀντί: ’in place of a woman’
__broaden__.δεῖσε: δείδω — fear; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔδεισε), + acc.: ’feared, was afraid of’ · also absolute, no object: ’was afraid’
__broaden__.εὐρυμέδων: Εὐρυμέδων — Eurymedon, Agamemnon’s attendant (εὐρύς ’wide’ + μέδων ’ruler’); masc. nom. sg. · also Eurymedon, attendant of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.
__broaden__.κακὴ: κακός — bad, evil, harmful; fem. nom. sg., agreeing with θύελλα · also fem. voc. sg. (as the nom.), in abuse: ’base, worthless’ (κακὴ γλήνη ’base doll’)
__broaden__.κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (τώ κε … ἠμύσειε ’then would collapse’) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε … ἔπασχον ’I would have suffered’) · also with an aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε σήκασθεν ’would have been penned’) · also + opt. in a condition after εἰ: ’if … might’
__broaden__.νέοι: νέος — young, new; masc. nom. pl. as a noun: ’young men’ · also adj., masc. nom. pl., agreeing with μαχηταί: ’young’
__broaden__.μελίφρονα: μελίφρων — honey-hearted, sweet to the heart; masc. acc. sg., epithet of wine · also masc. acc. sg., epithet of wheat (πυρόν): ’honey-hearted, heart-sweetening’
__broaden__.οὕς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. acc. pl., object of ἔπασχον: ’which (struggles)’ · also relative of persons, object of γνοίην: ’whom’ (οὕς κεν ἐῢ γνοίην ’whom I could recognise’) · also relative, object of ἑλόμην: ’which’ (of horses)
__broaden__.πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv.: ’once before’, with a finite verb · also with a participle: ’already, from before’ (πάρος μεμαυῖαν ’already eager’) · also correlative with πρίν, ’before (that)’ (πάρος … πρίν ’not … until’) · also + inf.: ’before’ (πάρος … γενέσθαι ’before … came to be’) · also adv. of anticipation: ’first, sooner’ (πάρος … δώσω ’I will give first’)
__broaden__.σῆμα: σῆμα — sign, mark; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’sign’ · also neut. acc. sg., predicate, with κικλήσκουσιν understood: ’tomb’ (σῆμα Μυρίνης ’the tomb of Myrine’) · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’a token’ (σῆμα ἰδέσθαι ’to see the token’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’tomb’ (ἀνδρὸς τόδε σῆμα ’the tomb of a man’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of τιθείς: ’a sign, an omen’
__broaden__.τάων: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic τῶν): partitive, ’of these’ · also governed by πρόσθ’: ’before these’ · also fem. gen. pl., antecedent of a relative: ’of those’ (τάων ἃς … ’of those which …’) · also relative, fem. gen. pl.: ’whose’ (τάων ἐν κονίῃσι ’in whose dust’)
__broaden__.τόδ: ὅδε — this (near the speaker); neut. acc. sg., elided (τόδ’ = τόδε) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’this’ (τόδ’ αἰνὸν ἄχος ’this dread grief’)
__broaden__.χείρεσσι: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic χερσί), instrumental: ’with the hands’ · also with ἐν, locative: ’in the hands’
__broaden__.ἀγαπήνωρ: Ἀγαπήνωρ — Agapenor, the Arcadian leader (son of Ancaeus); masc. nom. sg. · also ἀγαπήνωρ — man-cherishing, prizing manliness (ἀγαπάω + ἀνήρ; exact sense unknown); adj., masc. nom. sg., epithet of Eurymedon
__broaden__.ἁμὸν: ἁμός — my (Aeolic-epic form, = Attic ἐμός; ancient sources also read ’our’); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πατέρα · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with μένος: ’my’
__broaden__.ἄγχι: ἄγχι — near, close; adv.: ’close by’ · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
__broaden__.ἀμφοτέρω: ἀμφότερος — both; masc. acc. dual, agreeing with a dual noun: ’both’ · also masc. nom. dual, in apposition to a dual subject (τὼ … ἀμφοτέρω ’the two, both’)
__broaden__.ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
